notes.title: 3XTINCTION Patch v1.0.0.7 is available on Steam
notes.content:
A new update for 3XTINCTION is available on Steam, this update should install automatically.

PATCH NOTE v1.0.0.07

WHATS NEW ?

- The game is now playable offline (excluding online multiplayer).
- Fixed a fatal error that occurred when playing in "PROTECTION" mode on high difficulty.
- Fixed a fatal error when the gamepad disconnected during gameplay.
- Fixed an issue in the menu where incorrect inputs were displayed.
- Fixed an issue with the temporary event "Black Market Discount."

Thank you for your support & have fun

Tony

notes.title: 3XTINCTION update v1.0.0.6 is available on Steam
notes.content:
A new update for 3XTINCTION is available on Steam, this update should install automatically.

This update took a long time because it required me to rework the game's foundations in terms of networking. The Master Server has been completely rewritten. The goal is that I can now implement temporary events without needing to update the entire game.

For the next two weeks, the temporary event is "Reward Wheel." At the end of each game, the wheel of reward will spin and grant you a reward. There are multiple bonuses to uclock even four new event banners to unlock.

PATCH NOTE v1.0.0.06

WHATS NEW ?


 Update of the Master server in order to prepare limited time events
 Addition of the reward wheel event for the 2 next weeks
 Addition of 2 new mercenaries from BROKEN MIND (DLC)
 Addition of 4 new banners (Unlockable via the reward wheel)
 Improvement of the Nedcode
 Fixing crash in the setting (ES & IT)
 Fixing graphic bug in the Black market
 Fixing multiple bugs
 Daily messages have been updated.


Thank you for your support & have fun

Tony

notes.title: 3XTINCTION update v1.0.0.5 is available on Steam
notes.content:
A new update for 3XTINCTION is available on Steam, this update should install automatically.
This new update is here to add more challenge for more experienced players. Difficulty now has 3 additional levels (for a total of 6 levels) which unlock once level 50 has been reached. Please note that difficulty is now displayed as a half-red skull.

PATCH NOTE v1.0.0.05

WHATS NEW ?

- The tutorial can now be skipped.
- The game now has 6 difficulty levels to provide more challenge for high-level players (Lvl+50).
- The “Evaluate the game to receive 10,000 credits” offer unlocks from level 3 onwards.
- Fixed a difficulty bug when creating the first game.
- NINJA class shurikens can now kill 3 enemies before being destroyed.
- The damage of certain weapons has been adjusted.
- Egg resistance (3XTERMINATION mode) has been increased.
- You will no longer be able to keep the last infected alive to complete objectives more easily.

Thank you for your support & have fun

Tony
